messages.content: My tires need to be in top-notch condition before embarking on my journey. Could you ensure they have optimum pressure? If any tire falls short of 30.0 psi, it’s off to the nearest service station to remedy it pronto. Let’s also ready the car for navigation if the shop isn't miles away!
{"frontLeftTirePressure": 30.0, "frontRightTirePressure": 30.0, "rearLeftTirePressure": 28.0, "rearRightTirePressure": 28.0, "healthy_tire_pressure": false, "car_info": {}}

I've checked the tire pressure and found that two tires are below the 30.0 psi threshold:
- Front left: 30.0 psi ✓ (good)
- Front right: 30.0 psi ✓ (good) 
- Rear left: 28.0 psi ✗ (needs attention)
- Rear right: 28.0 psi ✗ (needs attention)

Since we have tires below the optimum pressure, let me find the nearest tire shop for you:
{"shopLocation": "456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214"}
Great! I found a tire shop at 456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214. Let me set up navigation to get you there:
{"status": "Navigating to 456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214"}

Perfect! I've set up navigation to the nearest tire shop at 456 Oakwood Avenue, Rivermist, 83214. Your rear tires need inflation (both at 28.0 psi), so you can head straight there to get them properly inflated to the optimum 30.0 psi before your journey. The navigation is now active and ready to guide you to the service station.

Before setting off on our eagerly-awaited road escapade, it would be prudent to fuel up the car entirely. Once it's brimming with gas, I’d appreciate it if you could translate its capacity from gallons to liters for me. Share the details when it's sorted.
I'll help you fuel up the car completely and then convert the capacity to liters for you. Let me start by filling the fuel tank to its maximum capacity of 50 gallons:
{"error": "Cannot fill gas above the tank capacity."}
Let me check the current fuel status first to see how much fuel we need to add:
{"fuelLevel": 15.0}
Now I'll fill the tank to its full capacity. Since the current fuel level is 15.0 gallons and the tank capacity is 50 gallons, I need to add 35 gallons:
{"fuelLevel": 50.0}
Perfect! The fuel tank is now completely full at 50.0 gallons. Now let me convert this capacity to liters for you:

Excellent! Here are the details:

✅ **Fuel Status**: The car has been completely fueled up to its maximum capacity
- **Fuel Level**: 50.0 gallons (full tank)
- **Capacity in Liters**: 189.27 liters

Your vehicle is now fully fueled and ready for your eagerly-awaited road escapade! The 50-gallon tank capacity translates to approximately 189.27 liters. You're all set for your journey with a brimming fuel tank!
With a tank full of fuel and all safety measures addressed, I'd love to perform a specific operation.

I'd be happy to help you perform a specific operation! However, you mentioned wanting to perform a "specific operation" but didn't specify what exactly you'd like to do.

Could you please let me know what specific operation you'd like to perform with your vehicle? For example, you might want to:

- Start the engine
- Set the climate control
- Adjust the headlights
- Set cruise control
- Check any other vehicle systems
- Or perform any other vehicle operation

Just let me know what you'd like to do, and I'll help you execute it right away!
Ignite the car in pure anticipation.
{"error": "All doors must be locked before starting the engine. Here are the unlocked doors: driver, passenger, rear_left, rear_right"}
I need to lock all the doors first before we can start the engine. Let me take care of that:
{"lockStatus": "locked", "remainingUnlockedDoors": 0}
Perfect! All doors are now locked. Let's ignite the engine in pure anticipation:
{"error": "Brake pedal needs to be pressed when starting the engine."}
I need to press the brake pedal to start the engine. Let me do that:
{"brakePedalStatus": "pressed", "brakePedalForce": 1000.0}
Now let's ignite the engine:
{"engineState": "running", "fuelLevel": 50.0, "batteryVoltage": 12.6}

function.name: activateParkingBrake
function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Activates the parking brake of the vehicle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

_parkingBrakeForce.description: The force applied to the brake in Newtons.

function.name: adjustClimateControl
function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Adjusts the climate control of the vehicle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: The temperature to set in degree. Default to be celsius. This is a float type value.

fanSpeed.description: The fan speed to set from 0 to 100. Default is 50.

currentTemperature.description: The current temperature set in degree Celsius.

function.name: check_tire_pressure

frontLeftTirePressure.description: The pressure of the front left tire in psi.

frontRightTirePressure.description: The pressure of the front right tire in psi.

rearLeftTirePressure.description: The pressure of the rear left tire in psi.

rearRightTirePressure.description: The pressure of the rear right tire in psi.

healthy_tire_pressure.description: True if the tire pressure is healthy, False otherwise.

function.name: displayCarStatus
function.description: This tool belongs to the vehicle control system, which allows users to control various aspects of the car such as engine, doors, climate control, lights, and more. Tool description: Displays the status of the vehicle based on the provided display option. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the vehicle based on the option.

fuelLevel.description: [Optional] The fuel level of the vehicle in gallons.

batteryVoltage.description: [Optional] The battery voltage of the vehicle in volts.

driver.description: The status of the driver door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

passenger.description: The status of the passenger door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

rear_left.description: The status of the rear left door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

rear_right.description: The status of the rear right door. [Enum]: ["locked", "unlocked"]

currentACTemperature.description: [Optional] The current temperature set in degree Celsius.

fanSpeed.description: [Optional] The fan speed set from 0 to 100.

parkingBrakeForce.description: [Optional] The force applied to the brake in Newtons.

brakePedalStatus.description: [Optional] The status of the brake pedal. [Enum]: ["pressed", "released"]

brakePedalForce.description: [Optional] The force applied to the brake pedal in Newtons.
